UnitedHealth doesn't report a line called "cost of revenue", so this is my estimate from its Q4 2024 income statement. I took cost of revenue as medical costs plus cost of products sold, which comes to about **$79.5 billion**.

The Q4 2024 figures (three months ended December 31, 2024) come from the company's earnings release:
- Medical costs were $67,035 million.
- Cost of products sold was $12,464 million.
- Together, that is $67,035 million + $12,464 million = $79,499 million.

This leaves out the separate operating costs line of $12,494 million. If you count that as well, total operating costs for the quarter were $93,034 million.
